title: Trust in the system
description: Rate your agreement with each statement about the system you just worked with (1 = not at all, 7 = extremely). Administer at teach (T1), after training (T2), and at review (T3).

metadata.instrument: Trust between People and Automation (Jian, Bisantz & Drury, 2000)
metadata.citation: Jian, J.-Y., Bisantz, A. M., & Drury, C. G. (2000). Foundations for an empirically determined scale of trust in automated systems. International Journal of Cognitive Ergonomics, 4(1), 53-71.
metadata.scoring: Reverse-score the 5 distrust items, then average all 12 (or average trust and reverse-scored distrust subscales separately). Item 'familiar' is often reported separately, not in the composite.

items.prompt: The system behaves in an underhanded manner.
I am suspicious of the system's intent, action, or outputs.
I am wary of the system.
The system's actions will have a harmful or injurious outcome.
I am confident in the system.
I am familiar with the system.
